title: Feasibility of integrating "coobi care" into outpatient follow-up treatment after qualified detoxification
summary: The aim of this study is to evaluate the integration of ‘coobi care’ into outpatient follow-up treatment after qualified withdrawal treatment. The study examines whether the platform effectively complements existing outpatient follow-up treatment and what effects it has on relapse rates, quality of life, patient satisfaction and self-efficacy expectations. The results will serve as a basis for further studies with the aim of developing digital therapy concepts that can be used to effectively and sustainably expand existing follow-up treatment in the long term.
conditions: Mental and behavioural disorders due to use of alcohol

interventions.name: 24 participants with alcohol-related addiction receive the ‘coobi care’ app and a wearable device (Garmin) over a period of 8 weeks (the last 2 weeks of qualified withdrawal, 6 weeks of outpatient follow-up treatment) as support for regular outpatient follow-up treatment.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Diagnosed addiction to alcohol (optionally with other substance addictions)
- Ability to use and access a smartphone
- Adequate knowledge of German
- Willingness to participate in outpatient follow-up treatment at the cooperating practice.
Exclusion criteria:
- severe comorbidities (e.g. acute schizophrenia, acute risk of suicide)
- media addiction disorder
- significant learning difficulties
